acceptance: Breakdown of where the added time goes, with evidence from CI durations and local profiling
Fixes that cut the step's wall time substantially without dropping coverage
Slow tests moved to the right marker where misclassified
Before/after CI timings recorded in the PR
description: The CI step "Run fast tests" grew from about 16 to about 45 minutes while the test count grew only about 1.4%, so per-test overhead rose sharply. The job timeout was raised to 60 minutes and `--durations=25` was added as a stopgap. Find where the time goes (fixtures, imports, xdist distribution, lock contention, slow tests misclassified as fast) and bring the step back down.
